training_description: Masked behaviour cloning in the PPO actor architecture from verified native PP and DLA trajectories; punctuality PPO ablation was rejected, not promoted
scope: Five fixed native Tutorial/UC2 infrastructures, at most3trains; native scheduled faults, fractional speeds and episode horizons retained; final variants are new timetables on these maps, not new-map generalization

dev20.scope: Development cases reused for selection; not independent holdout

final_interpretation: PP completes50/50 and the selected model48/50. Selected improves earlier learned baselines and DLA overall, but does not beat PP across all unseen variants. Lower lateness on jointly completed cases must not hide the two failures.
